title: Energy at the Start
text: At 20 m: Ep = mgh = (2)(10)(20) = 400 J, Ek = 0 (ball is dropped, not thrown). Total ME = 400 J.

title: Energy at 5 m
text: At 5 m: Ep = mgh = (2)(10)(5) = 100 J. Since ME is conserved: Ek = 400 - 100 = 300 J.

title: Finding Speed
text: Ek = ½mv², so 300 = ½(2)v², giving v² = 300 and v = √300 = 17.32 m/s.
